evidence: engineering assumptions; not measurements; D0 busy-loop firmware does not meet this budget

battery.pack_note: Supplier-built protected, matched 1S3P pack required. Do not hand-parallel loose cells.

connected_idle.description: BLE connected, display/camera/amp off, light sleep; not current D0 firmware

hud.description: MCU + BLE + assumed 150mW optical module; engine power unconfirmed

voice.description: capture or open-ear playback, phone ASR/network excluded

photo.description: camera on, JPEG capture, persistent local write

record.description: QVGA JPEG frame capture + SD; not H.264

transfer.description: burst Wi-Fi, storage read and MCU; not implemented in D0

thermal.note: Lumped steady-state sensitivity, not FEA or IEC limit. Cell/skin hotspot can be worse.
